payload.title: File:Saurichthys costasquamosus cast PIMUZ T 4102.jpg
payload.description_html: A cast of PIMUZ T 4102, an adult disarticulated skeleton of Saurichthys costasquamosus. The specimen was found at an outcrop on Monte San Giorgio preserving the late Anisian (Middle Triassic) Besano Formation. Photo taken at the Museo dei fossili del Monte San Giorgio in Meride, Switzerland.
